sources.scope: 181 valid distinct assessed registered-parcel geometries verified in thirteen bounded 0.001-degree cells around Calgary’s unchanged WUP locator. City metadata says these lands have registered parcels at Alberta Land Titles and excludes titled parking/storage units, machinery/equipment and linear property. This safe-field assessment geometry source is distinct from the paid municipal Ownership Parcel Fabric. Complete forced three-row pagination, all 181 fresh CPID reads, explicit absence, footprint and source binding passed in 22 checks/75 requests. The original ArcGIS-oriented harness falsely reported pagination failure because it did not log Socrata row arrays; that run remains preserved and a corrected fresh logger verifies 33 features over eleven nonempty pages. Independent GEOS found no invalid or duplicate geometries, sampled overlaps above 0.01 square metres or operation errors. The exact WUP point returned no intersecting feature; nearby examples are explicitly nearby. Source geometry is unchanged. The annual dataset is replaced each January; CPID continuity after replacement, wider coverage, legal title and survey accuracy remain unverified. Only geometry, CPID, transport row ID and modification date are requested.
sources.licenceNote: Public City open-data geometry; map notices informational. Annual replacement and CPID continuity unverified.
